answer: For agents selling summit routes or dune forecasts, eliminate the free-vote bonus for new accounts. Let voting weight equal the amount of earned credit locked through the decision and appeal window, using a linear rule across all keys. Splitting 100 credits into a spiral of aliases still yields only 100 units of influence. Additional influence requires additional locked credit, with an opportunity cost for the full window. This removes the advantage of identity splitting; it does not prevent wealthy actors from dominating or buying earned credit.
